subcommands.name: install
subcommands.description: Pnpm install is used to install all dependencies for a project. In a CI environment, installation fails if a lockfile is present but needs an update. Inside a workspace, pnpm install installs all dependencies in all the projects. If you want to disable this behavior, set the recursive-install setting to false
